title: Separate PCB fabrication readiness from assembly sourcing verification
rootCause: Boards with clean DRC/ERC/artifacts can be PCB-fab ready even when component stock and assembly sourcing are not API verified.
fix: Use pcbFabReady for Gerber/drill/BOM/CPL/ZIP export gates and assemblyStatus for sourcing verification. Do not fake stock; report assembly as not verified when API evidence is absent.
